gloss: everything; in all things; whatever happens

definitions.gloss: everything; in all things; all matters
definitions.explanation: Used to express that something applies to every situation or all matters without exception. Often used in maxims, advice, and general statements about life.

examples.japanese: {何事|なにごと}も{経験|けいけん}だ。
{何事|なにごと}も{最初|さいしょ}が{大事|だいじ}だ。
examples.english: In all things, the beginning is important.

examples.japanese: {何事|なにごと}も{中途半端|ちゅうとはんぱ}にせず、{最後|さいご}までやり{遂|とげ}げることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important not to leave anything half-done, but to see it through to the end.

notes:
A versatile expression commonly used in proverbs, life advice, and motivational statements. Adds a sense of universality—'in any and all things.' Slightly more literary and emphatic than simply saying {全部|ぜんぶ} or すべて.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {何事|なにごと}も{経験|けいけん}: everything is experience (a common saying)
- {何事|なにごと}も{最初|さいしょ}が{肝心|かんじん}: the beginning is crucial in everything
- {何事|なにごと}もなかったかのように: as if nothing had happened
- {何事|なにごと}も{程々|ほどほど}に: everything in moderation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- すべて: everything — neutral, general-purpose
- {全部|ぜんぶ}: everything, all — colloquial
- どんなことでも: whatever it may be — more conversational
